description: Add comprehensive structured logging to a Flask API application. Requirements: (1) Configure Python logging with formatters and handlers, (2) Implement request ID middleware using @app.before_request to generate UUID and store in Flask's g object, add X-Request-ID header via @app.after_request, (3) Add logging calls to at least 2 of the 3 endpoints (/api/payment, /api/balance, /api/transaction) with entry/exit logs including request_id context, (4) Create a timing decorator that measures execution duration and apply it to at least one endpoint, (5) Ensure sensitive data (password, token, credit_card, api_key) is NOT logged or is redacted with [REDACTED] markers, (6) All Python files must remain syntactically valid. Workspace: /home/ga/workspace/api_logging/. Save all modified files.
